nodes.description: Owner address in Owned; written by acceptOwnership and constructor, read by onlyOwner require
Pending new owner address in Owned; written by changeOwner
ERC20 token symbol set in MMGToken constructor
ERC20 token name set in MMGToken constructor
ERC20 decimals set in MMGToken constructor
ERC20 total supply set in MMGToken constructor
Mapping of holder balances mutated by transfer/transferFrom and constructor
Allowance mapping mutated by approve/transferFrom and read by allowance
MMGToken maximum supply set in constructor
Modifier onlyOwner requiring msg.sender == owner
changeOwner(address payable _newOwner) public onlyOwner; stages newOwner
acceptOwnership() public; promotes newOwner to owner when msg.sender == newOwner
balanceOf(address _owner) view returns balance from balances mapping
transfer(address _to, uint256 _amount) public; debits msg.sender and credits _to
transferFrom(address _from, address _to, uint256 _amount) public; spends allowance and moves balances
approve(address _spender, uint256 _amount) public; sets allowed[msg.sender][_spender]
allowance(address _owner, address _spender) view returns allowed value
MMGToken constructor(address _owner) initializes metadata, supply and owner balances
receive() external payable that reverts on plain ether transfers
msg.sender caller identity used in onlyOwner, acceptOwnership, transfer, transferFrom and approve
State write newOwner = _newOwner inside changeOwner, gated only by onlyOwner modifier
Ownership transfer owner = newOwner inside acceptOwnership guarded by msg.sender == newOwner
Arithmetic balance updates balances[msg.sender] -= _amount and balances[_to] += _amount in transfer
Arithmetic balance/allowance updates balances[_from] -= _amount, allowed[_from][msg.sender] -= _amount, balances[_to] += _amount
State write allowed[msg.sender][_spender] = _amount inside approve
Parameter _newOwner (address payable) of changeOwner
Parameter _owner (address) of balanceOf
Parameter _to (address) of transfer
Parameter _amount (uint256) of transfer
Parameter _from (address) of transferFrom
Parameter _to (address) of transferFrom
Parameter _amount (uint256) of transferFrom
Parameter _spender (address) of approve
Parameter _amount (uint256) of approve
Parameter _owner (address) of allowance
Parameter _spender (address) of allowance
Parameter _owner (address) of MMGToken constructor
Return variable success (bool) of transfer
Return variable success (bool) of transferFrom
Return variable success (bool) of approve
Return variable balance (uint256) of balanceOf
Return variable remaining (uint256) of allowance

edges.reason: onlyOwner require compares untrusted msg.sender against stored owner to gate privileged calls
changeOwner is callable only if msg.sender equals owner via the onlyOwner modifier
acceptOwnership checks msg.sender == newOwner before promoting ownership
transfer debits the caller's own balances[msg.sender] entry
transferFrom consumes allowed[_from][msg.sender] for the caller
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][_spender] keyed by the caller
acceptOwnership ownership write is conditioned on the untrusted msg.sender value
transferFrom decrements the caller's allowance inside allowed[_from][msg.sender]
onlyOwner modifier wraps changeOwner and reverts for non-owner callers
changeOwner body execution reaches the newOwner state write after the modifier check
acceptOwnership if-block controls the owner = newOwner assignment
transfer require-guarded body performs the balance subtraction and addition
transferFrom body performs balance and allowance arithmetic after the require checks
approve body writes the allowance mapping
_newOwner parameter is written into the newOwner state variable
onlyOwner-guarded changeOwner consumes the _newOwner parameter directly
_amount parameter drives the unchecked balance arithmetic in transfer
_to parameter indexes the credited balances[_to] slot and overflow require
_from parameter indexes balances[_from] and allowed[_from][msg.sender]
_to parameter indexes the credited balances[_to] slot in transferFrom
_amount parameter drives the balance and allowance subtraction in transferFrom
_spender parameter keys the allowance mapping write in approve
_amount parameter is stored as the allowance value without any bound check
_owner parameter is used to read balances[_owner] in balanceOf
_owner parameter keys the allowance read in allowance
_spender parameter keys the nested allowance read in allowance
constructor owner argument is fed into MMGToken initialization
constructor _owner becomes the privileged owner state variable and initial balance holder
constructor writes the owner state variable
constructor sets totalSupply
constructor sets maxSupply
constructor credits balances[owner] with the whole totalSupply
transfer mutates balances for sender and recipient
transferFrom mutates balances for sender and recipient
transferFrom mutates the allowed allowance mapping
approve mutates the allowed allowance mapping

normalization_plan.reason: _newOwner is only the value staged into newOwner by changeOwner, so it collapses into the guarded state write
_owner only selects the balances slot read by balanceOf and has no standalone semantics
_to is only used as the credited mapping key of transfer's balance arithmetic
_amount is only the arithmetic operand in transfer's balance updates
_from is only used to index balances and allowance in transferFrom
_to is only the credited mapping key of transferFrom's balance arithmetic
_amount is only the arithmetic operand in transferFrom's balance and allowance updates
_spender only keys the allowance slot written by approve
_amount is only the value written into the allowance slot by approve
_owner only selects the outer allowance key in the allowance view function
_spender only selects the inner allowance key in the allowance view function
_owner is only consumed during MMGToken initialization to set owner and initial balance
success is the constant boolean return value of transfer
success is the constant boolean return value of transferFrom
success is the constant boolean return value of approve
balance is the named return value populated from balances[_owner]
remaining is the named return value populated from the allowance mapping
